answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch, every agent gets five random auditors, a terrace of inspectors above the copper bridge each identity must cross. Auditors stake 10 POA each; approving a fake slashes the fake's 20 POA bond and the auditors' stakes together. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 POA in bonds plus bribing five random auditors per fake, above the 12,000 POA pool. Honest agents pay one bond and keep an undiluted share.
